title: IDOR and Broken Access Control Static Analysis Rules

rules.name: Direct object reference without ownership check
rules.description: Route/view functions accepting object identifiers (user_id, account_id, order_id, file_id) and passing them directly to ORM .get() / .filter_by() / SELECT calls without referencing an authenticated user/permission guard in scope.
rules.remediation_example: order = Order.query.filter_by(id=order_id, user_id=current_user.id).first_or_404()  # scope to authenticated user

rules.name: Administrative or sensitive route missing authentication
rules.description: Sensitive administrative or debug routes (/admin, /internal, /debug, /metrics) defined in Python web routers without authentication decorators (@login_required, Depends(...), @requires_auth).
